meta.title: 5-Day Marrakech, Atlas & Sahara Adventure | Shared Morocco Adventures
meta.description: A 5-day shared group tour from Marrakech to the Sahara at a slower pace — Ait Benhaddou, the Valley of Roses, Dades & Todra Gorges. From €428pp.
meta.ogDescription: A shared, fixed-date group tour from Marrakech to the Sahara desert with extra time in the Berber valleys along the way. From €428pp.

hero.lead: Marrakech → Ait Benhaddou → Dades Valley → Todra Gorge → Merzouga Desert Camp → Marrakech

overview.h2: The Sahara route, at a gentler pace
paras: Our 4-day Sahara tour condensed into a tight loop — this 5-day version spreads the same route over an extra day, giving you a full night in the Dades Valley and more time in the Berber villages along the Valley of Roses, instead of covering it all in one long drive.
Total driving distance is around 1,005 km round trip, shared with a small group the whole way.

days.label: Depart
days.title: Marrakech to Skoura via Ait Benhaddou
paras: Cross the High Atlas via the Tizi n'Tichka pass, stopping at the UNESCO-listed Ait Benhaddou kasbah, before continuing to the palm oasis of Skoura for the night.

days.label: Valleys
days.title: Skoura to Dades Gorge via the Valley of Roses
paras: Drive through the Valley of Roses, with a stop at a local cooperative, then on to the dramatic rock formations of the Dades Gorge for an evening walk and overnight stay.

days.label: Desert
days.title: Dades Gorge to Merzouga via Todra Gorge
paras: Morning hike into the towering Todra Gorge (≈55 km/1 hr from Dades), then continue across the desert plains to Merzouga (≈180 km/3.5 hrs). Camel trek into the Erg Chebbi dunes for a night at the shared desert camp.

days.label: Return
days.title: Sahara camp to Ouarzazate
paras: Optional sunrise over the dunes, then camels back to Merzouga and a scenic drive back across the Atlas via Tinghir, arriving in Ouarzazate for the night.

days.label: Arrive
days.title: Ouarzazate back to Marrakech
paras: Final crossing of the High Atlas, arriving back in Marrakech by mid-afternoon. Trip ends.

intro: Four nights, shared throughout. Expect the same style and price bracket as these real budget properties in each location.

cards.title: Nights 1–2 · Skoura & Dades
html: Night 1 in Skoura is a simple kasbah-style guesthouse; Night 2 in the Dades Gorges is Luxury Dades Riad or Auberge Tissadrin, half board (HB) — mudbrick rooms, terrace views, dinner included.

cards.title: Night 3 · Merzouga desert camp
html: Ideal Desert Camp, half board (HB) — a Berber-style camp at the edge of the Erg Chebbi dunes with dinner and breakfast included, campfire music, and a night under the stars.

cards.title: Night 4 · Ouarzazate
html: A budget guesthouse near the medina, similar in style and price to Le Petit Riad — clean, simple twin rooms and a rooftop terrace.

includes: Shared transport in an air-conditioned minivan
Camel trek and 1 night at the desert camp
excludes: Private rooms (available on request, extra cost)

good.h2: Same route, one less rushed day
paras: Groups are capped at 16 travelers. Departures run every Tuesday year-round — book early for October–April, our busiest season.
Prefer the tighter 4-day version instead? See our 4-Day Sahara Desert Group Tour.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure, final price, and payment instructions by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.q: How is this different from the 4-Day Sahara tour?
items.a: Same core route, but spread over an extra day — you get a full night in the Dades Valley and more time in the Valley of Roses, rather than driving straight through.
Yes — the €428 price is based on shared twin or dorm-style rooms throughout. A private room upgrade is available on request for an additional cost.

items.q: What should I pack for the desert night?
items.a: Desert nights get cold even in summer — bring a warm layer, plus sunscreen, a scarf or hat for wind and sun, and comfortable walking shoes.

items.q: Can I join this trip as a solo traveler?
items.a: Absolutely — most travelers on this route arrive solo. You'll be paired with a same-gender roommate for shared rooms unless you book a private upgrade.

items.q: What if the group doesn't fill up?
items.a: Departures run on fixed weekly dates regardless of group size — your trip runs even if only a few seats are booked.
